title: Ulyana and the Asset Revisited
premise: Dominic Villalobos, a deniable fixer for an unlisted embassy in Vienna, is ordered to escort a quiet asset named Ulyana onto a dawn extraction flight—until the flight's records vanish mid-air and the plane itself becomes a ghost. Digging for answers, Dominic discovers the disappearance was staged to cover an attack on the embassy's real client, scheduled to look like a maintenance accident, and that his own agency sanctioned it. Torn between duty and the truth he owes Ulyana, whose brother is among the targets, Dominic races through one night of forged manifests, burned contacts, and betrayals. He stops the attack at the cost of exposing himself, and he and Ulyana board the re-materialized flight not as handler and asset but as fugitives choosing each other.
about_author: Freya Hartwell is a former aviation logistics analyst who spent a decade writing training manuals for people who were never officially there. She lives near three international airports and claims this is coincidence.

chapters.title: The Go-Bag Rule
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. A routine morning establishing his tradecraft: packed bag, polished cover story, a dead-drop errand for the embassy that isn't listed anywhere. He notices Ulyana watching him from across the café and files it away as a problem. Emotional beat: controlled complacency about to crack.

chapters.title: Asset 7-Kilo
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. She reveals she has been cataloguing Dominic's habits for weeks—not as a threat but because she suspects her recruitment was never what it seemed. Their first real conversation over coffee, all subtext. Emotional beat: wary mutual recognition.

chapters.title: Extraction Order
chapters.summary: Dominic receives the dawn extraction order for Ulyana and preps the flight manifest. Small wrongnesses accumulate: a tail number that doesn't match, a handler who won't use names on the phone. Emotional beat: professional unease hardening into dread.

chapters.title: Vanishing Altitude
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV, night. The flight goes dark—not crashed, erased. Radar history, booking records, even his own confirmation email rewrite themselves. He stands on the tarmac road watching empty sky. Emotional beat: vertigo of unreality.

chapters.title: What the Records Say
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. She shows Dominic a printout she made hours before the erasure—the only surviving copy—and admits she copied it because she never trusted them. First alliance formed out of shared paranoia. Emotional beat: trust as a calculated gamble.

chapters.title: The Embassy That Isn't
chapters.summary: Dominic breaks into the station's back office and finds the flight was never meant to arrive; its ghosting is cover for something scheduled at 05:40. His own name appears on an internal list marked 'disposable.' Emotional beat: betrayal by the institution that owns him.

chapters.title: Burned Contacts
chapters.summary: Dominic works his network of fixers, smugglers, and a disgraced air-traffic controller, burning each contact after use. Two refuse to help; one sells him out within the hour. Emotional beat: loneliness of a man whose currency is secrets now spent.

chapters.title: Her Brother's Name
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. She decodes the target list hidden in the manifest and finds her brother, an engineer at the facility slated for the 'accident.' She confronts Dominic with the choice: extract her or save them—he can't do both by dawn. Emotional beat: love weaponized into ultimatum.

chapters.title: The Maintenance Lie
chapters.summary: Dominic infiltrates the charter company and finds the sabotage plan dressed as a routine inspection failure. He photographs everything, knowing the photos mark him. Emotional beat: crossing the point of no return.

chapters.title: Handler Down
chapters.summary: The station sends cleaners after Dominic. A brutal chase through Vienna's sewers and service tunnels; he escapes using routes only a fixer would know, but loses his go-bag—his identity, cash, and legend—in the water. Emotional beat: stripped bare.

chapters.title: Safehouse Confessions
chapters.summary: Both POVs interleaved. In a borrowed safehouse, Dominic and Ulyana trade their real histories: how each was recruited, what they were promised. For the first time the lies between them are gone. Emotional beat: intimacy born of ruin.

chapters.title: The Client
chapters.summary: Dominic identifies the attack's true beneficiary—a defense contractor whose contract dies if the facility passes inspection. The 'accident' is paperwork with bodies attached. Emotional beat: cold clarity about who writes the orders.

chapters.title: Twelve Hours
chapters.summary: Ticking-clock chapter. They split tasks: Ulyana contacts her brother's union contacts inside the facility while Dominic forges credentials to reach the flight line. Every step is watched. Emotional beat: desperate competence.

chapters.title: The Man Who Sold Him
chapters.summary: Dominic confronts his mentor, the station chief who put him on the disposable list. Not a fight—a negotiation. The chief offers reinstatement if Dominic walks away before dawn. Emotional beat: loyalty tested against self-preservation.

chapters.title: Inspection Day
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV inside the facility. She and her brother's colleagues stage a work stoppage timed to delay the 'maintenance window' the saboteurs need. Small human victories against machinery. Emotional beat: ordinary courage.

chapters.title: Ghost Flight Returns
chapters.summary: Dominic discovers the vanished flight's true cargo: the saboteurs and equipment, flying under its resurrected identity. To stop the attack he must ground a plane that officially does not exist. Emotional beat: absurdity sharpened to a blade.

chapters.title: Runway Lights
chapters.summary: Climax begins. Dominic triggers a false emergency that forces the ghost flight to divert, while Ulyana's stoppage strands the ground team. The contractor's security force closes in on both of them. Emotional beat: everything converging at once.

Climax. The attack fails by four minutes. Dominic faces the station chief on the tarmac—gun drawn, dawn breaking—and chooses truth over duty, broadcasting the evidence rather than silencing it. He takes a bullet graze; the chief is arrested by the very agency cleaning house. Emotional beat: sacrifice rewarded with survival, barely.

chapters.title: Aftermath of an Accident That Wasn't
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Official reports call it a mechanical delay; the contractor burns quietly; his name is struck from every list—including existence. He is free and unemployed in the same instant. Emotional beat: hollow victory.

chapters.title: Two Tickets
chapters.summary: Ulyana's POV. The re-listed extraction flight leaves at noon, two seats, no handler designation. Her brother is safe; her debts to the agency are voided by scandal. She waits at the gate, unsure he'll come. Emotional beat: hope held at arm's length.

chapters.title: Boarding
chapters.summary: Dominic arrives with nothing but the clothes he escaped in and the truth in his pocket. No go-bag, no legend, no employer. He boards beside her. Emotional beat: choosing love without a safety net.

chapters.title: Unlisted
chapters.summary: Epilogue, alternating POVs above the clouds. They compare notes on who they used to be and draft new names for who they'll be next. Somewhere below, the embassy that doesn't exist erases another file. Emotional beat: peace purchased at full price, finally paid.
